items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I got Oscar the gig... Oscar had met this doctor... so that we could play the USO camps -- which he did. We all got together.

ctx.x: And Oscar. Oscar was on it with you.
Yeah. I got Oscar the gig.

items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Sir Charles, Oscar Pettiford, Denzil Best, me and Hawk. And Hawk and I, at that time, we had gotten pretty tight together... So we had a very mutual agreement as far as playing was concerned

ctx.x: joint -- they had after-hours joints I'd play. And that's where I met Oscar Pettiford and the Pettiford Family, the brothers and... Let me see, who else did I meet up there? That bass player, a helluva bass player. Adolphus...
